description: Audit of the TGV Re=1600 dissipation-peak reference anchor. The canonical van Rees et al. (2011) 512^3 spectral file distributed by the 1st High-Order CFD Workshop (code/solver/psref/spectral_Re1600_512.gdiag, retrieved 2026-07-10 from https://cfd.ku.edu/hiocfd/data.tgz) gives the true peak; the in-repo pseudospectral reference (ps_reference.py, 2/3 de-aliased, SSP-RK3) confirms it independently. The manuscript's previous anchor 1.25e-2 is a factual error (2.8% low) and every percent-of-reference number computed against it is invalid.

published_reference.source: van Rees, Leonard, Pullin, Koumoutsakos, JCP 230 (2011), 512^3 de-aliased spectral, workshop data file
published_reference.identity_check: peak -dE/dt equals 2*nu*Z at the peak instant exactly in the file (nu = 1/1600)

consequence: BMC9 native-curl 64^3 peak previously reported as 102% of the anchor is 99.1% of the true anchor; the '100% at 128^3' statement does not survive. All headline percentages must be recomputed against 1.285753e-2 with the common postprocessor.
